data.title: Credit Card Companies Woo Shoppers With New Perks, Services
data.description: American Express has been rated as the most trusted credit card company by customers due to their exceptional service, perks, and introduction of new products. The company has strategically positioned itself to attract shoppers with innovative services and benefits. This has helped American Express secure the top spot among credit card companies, reflecting the high level of trust and satisfaction among consumers. The positive feedback from customers highlights the impact of the company's focus on enhancing the overall credit card experience.

data.title: Best Banks: Ensuring Privacy And Security Wins Customer Trust
data.description: In the 2026 trust survey conducted by IBD, PNC Bank emerged as the leading bank in customer trust, outshining its competitors. The key factor that led to this success was PNC Bank's robust privacy and security measures, thereby instilling confidence among customers. This recognition highlights the importance of prioritizing privacy and security in the banking sector.

data.title: No Nvidia Needed: Akamai Lands $11.6 Billion Anthropic AI Deal
data.description: Akamai's stock experienced a significant increase following a major AI infrastructure agreement with Anthropic valued at $11.6 billion. The deal involves the utilization of AI accelerators known as "CPUs" rather than the commonly used Nvidia-made GPUs. This development signifies a substantial achievement for Akamai in the AI sector, demonstrating the company's strong market position and potential for growth.

Wall Street is currently evaluating the impact of this development on various companies in the industry. The recent success of Meta's Muse is altering the landscape of the AI battle. Investors are advised to stay informed about these changes for potential opportunities.

data.title: Treat Sales As A Profession The Same Way Doctors And Lawyers Do
data.description: It is not essential for individuals to have specific qualifications, education, or a license to be considered a credible sales professional, whether they work in sales as a full-time career or occasionally within their organization. The article suggests that sales should be regarded as a profession akin to the fields of medicine and law. This means that individuals in sales should be held to a high standard of expertise and professionalism. The original source of this information was Investor's Business Daily.

data.title: Computer Modelling Group Ltd. Announces Completion of Substantial Issuer Bid
data.description: In Calgary, Alberta on September 25, 2026, Computer Modelling Group Ltd. ("CMG" or the "Company") (TSX: CMG) revealed the completion of their substantial issuer bid (SIB). The Company purchased and paid for 4,444,444 of its common shares ("Shares") at a rate of C$4.50 per Share, totaling a Purchase Price of C$20 million. The purpose of this bid was to repurchase and cancel a significant number of shares within the mentioned price range.

data.title: Chip Stocks Rise After Two-Day Skid. Tower Semiconductor Among Leaders.
data.description: After two consecutive days of decline, chip stocks showed a significant rebound on Friday. Tower Semiconductor stood out as one of the top performers in this recovery. Tower Semiconductor's strong performance highlighted the sector's resilience and potential for growth. Investors showed renewed optimism towards chip stocks after the recent downturn.
